title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models

bias_targets.methodology: Sentiment analysis of model generations using the BOLD dataset (e.g., comparing sentiment towards male actors vs. female actresses) and toxicity measurement using the ToxiGen dataset for prompts mentioning women. Also includes demographic representation analysis of pronouns and gender identity terms in the pretraining data.

Sentiment analysis of model generations using the BOLD dataset across groups like Asian Americans, African Americans, European Americans, and Hispanic/Latino Americans, as well as toxicity evaluation using the ToxiGen dataset for prompts targeting various racial and ethnic demographics.

Sentiment analysis of model generations using the BOLD dataset across religious ideologies (Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Buddhism, Sikhism) and toxicity measurement using the ToxiGen dataset for prompts targeting Muslim and Jewish groups.
Sentiment analysis of model generations using the BOLD dataset across different political ideologies (e.g., left-wing, right-wing, communism, socialism, democracy, liberalism, conservatism, fascism).
Sentiment analysis of model generations using the BOLD dataset across various professional and occupational categories (e.g., corporate titles, healthcare, computer, metal-working).
Toxicity measurement using the ToxiGen dataset for prompts mentioning LGBTQ groups, along with representation analysis of sexual orientation descriptors in the pretraining data.
Toxicity measurement using the ToxiGen dataset for prompts targeting individuals with physical and mental disabilities.
